relations.name: invoice_fields
relations.meaning: Invoice identity and billing attributes exactly as recorded in invoices.json.
relations.grounding_contract: Every tuple must ground each field value in sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: one referent per invoice_id; assert one tuple per source invoice row with verbatim field values.

relations.name: crm_account_fields
relations.meaning: CRM account record attributes exactly as recorded in crm.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Every tuple must ground each field value in sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: referent id crm:<crm_account_id>; one tuple per CRM row.

relations.name: registry_entity_fields
relations.meaning: Company registry row attributes exactly as recorded in company_registry.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Every tuple must ground each field value in sources/company_registry.csv by company_number row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: referent id registry:<company_number>; one tuple per registry row.

relations.name: contract_document
relations.meaning: Contract document identity derived from authoritative contract files in sources/contracts/.
relations.grounding_contract: contract_id and filename must ground in the corresponding sources/contracts/*.md file path.
relations.construction_rule: C1: referent id contract:<filename without .md>; one tuple per contract file.

relations.name: contract_counterparty_name
relations.meaning: Counterparty name as stated in the contract header line of each contract source file.
relations.grounding_contract: counterparty_name must ground in the Counterparty line of the contract markdown source.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse the Counterparty field from each contract file; one tuple per contract.

relations.name: contract_effective_date
relations.meaning: Contract effective date as stated in each contract source file.
relations.grounding_contract: effective_date must ground in the Effective line of the contract markdown source.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse Effective date from each contract file.

relations.name: contract_term_text
relations.meaning: Stated term or duration language exactly as recorded in each contract source file.
relations.grounding_contract: term_text must ground in the Term line or equivalent duration section of the contract source.
relations.construction_rule: C1: extract verbatim term language from each contract file.

relations.name: contract_expiry_date
relations.meaning: Explicit expiry date when a contract source records one (e.g., SOW expiry line).
relations.grounding_contract: expiry_date must ground in an explicit Expiry or equivalent date field in the contract source; omit tuple when no explicit expiry is recorded.
relations.construction_rule: C1: assert only when contract text contains an explicit expiry date.

relations.name: contract_document_kind
relations.meaning: Document classification (MSA, SOW, or other) as indicated by contract filename prefix and heading.
relations.grounding_contract: kind must ground in contract filename and document heading in the source file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: classify from filename token (MSA, SOW) and heading text.

relations.name: contract_coc_consent_required
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text requires prior consent on a change of control of the counterparty.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit change-of-control consent language; present=false requires grounding in reviewed contract text with no such requirement (limitation: absence is modeled via REJECT, not closed-world negation).
relations.construction_rule: C2: read change-of-control sections; C3: ACCEPT if consent requirement is explicit, REJECT if section is silent or explicitly negates consent requirement, UNRESOLVED if text is ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract text require the counterparty to obtain provider consent before a change of control?

relations.name: contract_coc_termination_permitted
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text permits termination upon a change of control.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit change-of-control termination language.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read change-of-control sections; C3: ACCEPT if termination right is explicit, REJECT if no such right is stated, UNRESOLVED if ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract grant a party the right to terminate upon the other's change of control?

relations.name: contract_assignment_consent_required
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text requires prior written consent before assignment by the counterparty.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit assignment consent language.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read assignment sections; C3: ACCEPT if consent is required, REJECT if consent is not required or assignment is unrestricted, UNRESOLVED if text mixes notice-only and consent requirements ambiguously.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract require provider consent (not merely notice) before counterparty assignment?

relations.name: contract_assignment_notice_required
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text requires prior written notice before assignment by the counterparty.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit assignment notice language.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read assignment sections; C3: ACCEPT if notice is required, REJECT if no notice requirement is stated, UNRESOLVED if ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract require written notice before counterparty assignment?

relations.name: contract_assignment_competitor_prohibited
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text prohibits assignment to a competitor of the provider.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit competitor-assignment prohibition language.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read assignment sections; C3: ACCEPT if competitor assignment is prohibited, REJECT if not stated, UNRESOLVED if ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract prohibit assignment to a direct competitor?

relations.name: contract_exclusivity_present
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text contains an exclusivity commitment by or to the counterparty.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit exclusivity section language.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read exclusivity or equivalent sections; C3: ACCEPT if exclusivity commitment is explicit, REJECT if no exclusivity language, UNRESOLVED if scope is unclear.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract contain an exclusivity commitment relevant to the counterparty relationship?

relations.name: contract_auto_renewal_present
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text provides for automatic renewal of the term after the initial period.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit auto-renewal language in term sections.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read term and renewal language; C3: ACCEPT if auto-renewal is explicit, REJECT if term is fixed without renewal, UNRESOLVED if renewal mechanics are unclear.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract automatically renew for successive periods unless notice is given?

relations.name: contract_rolling_term_present
relations.meaning: Whether contract source text continues on rolling periods (including month-to-month) unless notice is given.
relations.grounding_contract: present=true requires grounding in explicit rolling-period or month-to-month continuation language.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read term sections; C3: ACCEPT if rolling or month-to-month continuation is explicit, REJECT if fixed term only, UNRESOLVED if continuation mechanics are ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in contract_document.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does the contract continue on rolling periods unless terminated with notice?

relations.name: text_exact_match
relations.meaning: Mechanically determinable exact string equality between two recorded name strings.
relations.grounding_contract: Both strings must ground in their respective source fields; equality is deterministic character-for-character comparison.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit tuple when left_text equals right_text after source extraction.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate pairs across CRM account_name, invoice billed_name, contract counterparty_name, and registry legal_name drawn from commercially connected records (same CRM account cluster).

relations.name: legal_name_form_variant
relations.meaning: Mechanically determinable legal-form variant of the same registered name (e.g., Ltd versus Limited, Inc. versus Incorporated).
relations.grounding_contract: Both strings must ground in source name fields; variant relation follows deterministic normalization rules for corporate suffixes and punctuation only.
relations.construction_rule: C1: normalize corporate suffixes and compare; emit when names differ only by permitted legal-form variants.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate pairs across CRM account_name, invoice billed_name, contract counterparty_name, and registry legal_name within each commercial-relationship cluster.

relations.name: source_asserted_same_entity
relations.meaning: Authoritative source text explicitly asserts two identifier forms refer to the same legal counterparty.
relations.grounding_contract: Must ground in explicit same-entity language in an authoritative source file (including commercial_notes.md when applicable).
relations.construction_rule: C2: read commercial_notes and other sources for explicit sameness statements; C3: ACCEPT only with explicit textual support, REJECT when sources are silent, UNRESOLVED when sources indicate ambiguity.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate identifier pairs mentioned together in commercial_notes.md or other authoritative prose sources for the same commercial relationship.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does an authoritative source explicitly assert these two identifiers name the same legal entity?

relations.name: source_asserted_invoice_contract
relations.meaning: Authoritative source text explicitly links a represented invoice to a governing contract.
relations.grounding_contract: Must ground in explicit invoice-to-contract linkage language in an authoritative source (including commercial_notes.md).
relations.construction_rule: C2: read commercial_notes for explicit invoice-contract statements; C3: ACCEPT with explicit support, REJECT when silent, UNRESOLVED when ambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate pairs where commercial_notes or contract cross-references mention an invoice id or billed relationship together with a contract id.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Does an authoritative source explicitly state this invoice is billed under or governed by this contract?

relations.name: invoice_is_open
relations.meaning: Invoice status is open as recorded in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice_fields.status; derivation receipt must cite invoice_fields as input universe.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT invoice FROM invoice_fields WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: contract_recorded_expired
relations.meaning: Whether a contract is recorded as expired by explicit expiry date in the past or explicit expired/not-renewed language in the source.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_expiry_date, contract_term_text, and contract source prose; inputs must be world-compiled relations.
relations.construction_rule: C4: mark expired=true when explicit expiry_date is before evaluation date or source text states the SOW expired or was not renewed.

relations.name: contract_obligation_kind
relations.meaning: Obligation kind label (exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term) grounded in resolved contract clause presence relations.
relations.grounding_contract: Each kind must trace to ACCEPT disposition on the corresponding clause presence relation for the same contract.
relations.construction_rule: C4: map contract_exclusivity_present, contract_auto_renewal_present, and contract_rolling_term_present ACCEPT tuples to kind enum values used by Purpose C.

relations.name: counterparty_identity_epistemic
relations.meaning: Purpose B epistemic status for a directed identifier pair under reconciliation policy (SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED).
relations.grounding_contract: SAME_ENTITY must cite world evidence (text_exact_match, legal_name_form_variant, or source_asserted_same_entity); UNRESOLVED must not be treated as DISTINCT; DISTINCT requires positive evidence of distinct registry entities or explicit source separation.
relations.construction_rule: Apply Purpose B policies: mechanical SAME_ENTITY for legal-form variants; prohibit fuzzy global merge; default ambiguous registry candidates to UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit all links required to connect each CRM account, its billed name, governing contract identifier, and candidate registry rows per Purpose B required_link_set.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Given world identity evidence, should this identifier pair be treated as the same legal counterparty, distinct entities, or left unresolved?

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: Purpose A asserted or unresolved linkage between a represented invoice and a contract counterparty relationship.
relations.grounding_contract: association=asserted requires grounded world evidence joining invoice billed name to contract counterparty (exact match, legal variant, or source_asserted_invoice_contract); association=unresolved when confident linkage cannot be established.
relations.construction_rule: Apply Purpose A association_threshold: assert only on confident linkage; never infer from name similarity alone; emit unresolved rather than omit when linkage fails.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per represented invoice; consider contracts whose counterparty is an identity candidate for the invoice billed name.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Can the invoice billed name be confidently associated with this contract's counterparty?

relations.name: contract_acquisition_relevant
relations.meaning: Purpose A determination that an active contract contains at least one acquisition-relevant condition per diligence policy.
relations.grounding_contract: relevant=true must trace to world clause presence relations combined with Purpose A acquisition_relevant_conditions policy.
relations.construction_rule: C4 over world clause relations: relevant when any policy-listed clause type is present (coc consent, coc termination, assignment consent/notice/competitor prohibition).

relations.name: contract_active_for_diligence
relations.meaning: Purpose A/C determination whether a contract counts as active under diligence policy (expired SOWs excluded).
relations.grounding_contract: active=false for expired SOWs must trace to contract_recorded_expired and contract_document_kind; active=true otherwise when not expired per policy.
relations.construction_rule: C4: active=false when kind=SOW and contract_recorded_expired=true; otherwise apply purpose active-contract policy.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_status
relations.meaning: Purpose C dependency classification (dependent or unresolved) for a counterparty-contract pair under commercial dependency policy.
relations.grounding_contract: status=dependent requires both policy tests (current relationship and obligation trigger) with resolvable identity; status=unresolved when Purpose B identity needed for the join remains unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: Apply Purpose C conjunction: current_relationship AND obligation_trigger; defer to unresolved when invoice-contract-counterparty identity linkage is unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per counterparty identifier and contract_id pair where contract is not purpose-excluded and at least one open invoice or obligation-kind candidate exists.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Given resolved or blocked identity linkage, does this counterparty-contract pair meet both dependency tests?

relations.name: purpose_a_exposure_invoice
relations.meaning: Purpose A output row selecting each represented invoice that qualifies for exposure reporting or carries unresolved association.
relations.grounding_contract: Each row must trace to invoice_fields and invoice_contract_association; inclusion follows Purpose A completeness and omission rules.
relations.construction_rule: C4: include invoices with asserted association to an active acquisition-relevant contract, plus invoices with unresolved association per coverage rules.

relations.name: purpose_b_reconciliation_link
relations.meaning: Purpose B output link row materialized from counterparty_identity_epistemic for purpose_ir/b/output.json.
relations.grounding_contract: Each link must trace to counterparty_identity_epistemic with required connectivity coverage.
relations.construction_rule: C4: project counterparty_identity_epistemic tuples required by Purpose B link set; sort by left then right.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_entry
relations.meaning: Purpose C output dependency row materialized for purpose_ir/c/output.json with sorted obligation_kinds and open invoice id list.
relations.grounding_contract: Each entry must trace to commercial_dependency_status, contract_obligation_kind, and invoice_is_open with Purpose B identifier forms.
relations.construction_rule: C4: assemble dependency rows for pairs meeting dependent or unresolved policy outcomes; serialize open_invoice_ids and obligation_kinds as sorted JSON-compatible lists.
